primary_factor_metrics: seed-paired oracle MSE on intersection of legal forecast ticks across all cells, independently for each latent path and dataset; five contrasts per strategy/scenario: feature high vs clean, MCAR55 vs 0, long vs short, feature x missingness, feature x delay
primary_selection_metrics: observed minus oracle MSE on the same fixed forecast cohort, for MCAR55, MAR, MNAR under clean feature and short lag
comparison: 48-family simultaneous conservative t intervals, df23, seed unit; missing/mismatched pairs inconclusive, no fabricated score; exploratory ties within 1e-12
quality: valid use; unavailable, degraded or unknown abstain and exclude from fit on all baselines without changing planned denominator; invalid abort without valid score
large_error: Exploratory absolute prediction error greater than 1 target unit, separately counted against fixed planned denominator; no forecast never counted as zero error.
cost: 0.02 per activated update, exclude initialization, per planned tick and per observed common scored tick reported separately from pure loss
